title: Rebuilt this site and ran a fact audit on its numbers
what_changed: This site went from a game-themed page to a professional portfolio. A planning model wrote the spec, a builder agent worked through it from a task board, and served screenshots were reviewed before it went live [K:t_fe967bff]. The diagrams and charts are now 14 inline SVG figures, each with a data table.
why_it_matters: I mapped 380 numbers on the site to a source line [K:t_fe967bff]. A script measures diagram text on 23 pages at 3 screen widths. Rows under the 13px floor went from 18 to 0 [K:t_fe967bff].
result: Merged and live on 3 Oct 2026, with 0 failing rows on the text size check [K:t_fe967bff].
lesson: An earlier draft contained claims that did not match my records, and the fact audit caught them before release. An automated review also passed a build with visible defects, so every release now gets a separate check of the rendered pages before it goes live.

diagram.title: How a site change moves from plan to merge
diagram.desc: Five steps left to right: plan, build, fact audit, screenshot review, merge. A return arrow runs from fact audit back to build, labelled fabricated draft discarded.
diagram.caption: The fact audit sits between build and review. When it fails, the build goes back with the unmatched claims listed.
